messages.text:
"Create an ultra-detailed, hyper-immersive, expansive, long-form, and production-ready 3D detailed pixel-art survival horror and laboratory escape game titled \"Ape Project\". The entire game world—spanning a secure 15x15m subterranean laboratory lobby with interactive hydraulic security doors, an expansive 500x500m slightly hilly sparse jungle exterior, a Lethal-Ape-inspired agile player model, and the terrifying blind auditory apex predator \"Mossman\"—must be rendered strictly through high-fidelity 3D pixel-art engines combined with dynamic voxel-grid physics, atmospheric lighting shaders, and crisp pixel texture mapping, completely avoiding flat 2D sprites, rigid 8-bit retro restrictions, or modern high-poly realistic models. All visual assets, hydraulic pneumatic animations, particle trails, and creature AI behaviors are dynamically generated in real-time.
1. Laboratory Lobby @COMMENT_BODY@ Hydraulic Door Architecture (15x15M)
The Starting Sanctuary: Upon launching a new session, the player spawns securely inside a high-tech subterranean laboratory lobby measuring precisely 15x15 meters.
Interior Environment @COMMENT_BODY@ Assets: The room features grid-aligned metallic walls, industrial flooring, and detailed 3D pixel-art laboratory racks and storage shelving units lined with glass beakers, chemical containers, and computer terminals with crisp pixel textures.
4-Way Hydraulic Security System: Heavy, reinforced pneumatic hydraulic doors are embedded directly into the left, right, front, and back walls of the laboratory.
Interactive Left-Side Control Switches: Each door features a tactile mechanical control switch positioned precisely on the left side of the door frame. Players must manually interact with this switch to trigger the smooth, weighted hydraulic open and close cycle, controlling safe egress into the outside world.
2. Exterior Open-World Jungle Map (500x500M)
The Wilderness Expanse: Stepping past the laboratory doors leads directly into a massive, open-world jungle map measuring 500x500 meters in total scale.
Terrain Morphology @COMMENT_BODY@ Foliage: The landscape features slightly rolling, hilly terrain that creates natural elevation changes, valleys, and line-of-sight blockades, sparsely populated with scattered 3D pixel-art trees that provide open tracking fields mixed with tactical cover points.
3. Player Character Architecture @COMMENT_BODY@ Lethal-Ape Animation Framework
Player Model (Lethal Ape Style): A highly detailed, rugged 3D pixel-art ape character model directly inspired by the iconic movement mechanics and silhouette of Lethal Ape, rendered with clean, high-definition pixel texturing.
Animation @COMMENT_BODY@ Locomotion System: Features ultra-smooth pixel animation frames for quadrupedal sprinting, upright walking, fluid climbing over hilly terrain, crouching, and responsive first-person or third-person camera switching.
4. Apex Predator Ecosystem: The Mossman
The primary terror roaming the 500x500m outdoor jungle, hunting relentlessly through acoustic tracking:
Monster Designation: Mossman
Spawn Zone: Deployed natively across the outdoor jungle map.
Physical Morphology @COMMENT_BODY@ Appearance:
Height @COMMENT_BODY@ Build: A towering, muscular ape-like entity standing at 2.8 meters tall.
Color @COMMENT_BODY@ Texture: Covered in vibrant moss-green base skin intricately woven with dark green moss stripes winding across and around its entire massive body, styled with detailed pixel shading.
Facial Features: Completely eyeless (devoid of any optical organs or eyes), featuring only a wide, unsettlingly visible mouth stretching across its lower face.
Combat @COMMENT_BODY@ Movement Metrics:
Top Movement Speed: Blistering fast at 33 KM/h.
Turning Agility @COMMENT_BODY@ Inertia: 50% turning difficulty/resistance, meaning the creature possesses realistic momentum and requires wide, sweeping arcs to change direction at top speed.
Sensory System @COMMENT_BODY@ Unique Abilities:
Acoustic Tracking: Completely blind to visual stimuli, but equipped with Super-Sensitive Hearing that instantly detects player footsteps, running ripples, and hydraulic door activations across the map.
Green Particle Trail Ability: As the Mossman walks and prowls through the jungle terrain, it continuously emits glowing, ethereal green particle effects from its body mass and footprints, leaving a haunting visual wake in the dark forest.
5. Visual Art Direction @COMMENT_BODY@ Detailed Pixel Polish
3D Pixel-Art Fidelity: Crisp, hand-crafted 3D pixel texture atlases mapped onto low-poly meshes, utilizing rich color palettes, atmospheric volumetric fog rolling over the hilly terrain, and dynamic shadow casting.
Immersive Audio Soundscape: Heavy pneumatic hisses and metal clanks for the laboratory doors, eerie ambient jungle wildlife noises, and sharp acoustic audio cues that reward stealth and punish excessive noise in the presence of the Mossman.

"
